content: विश्लेषः .²1 Disunion, disjunction. .²2 Especially separation of lovers, or of husband and wife. .²3 Separation (in general); तनयाविश्लेषदुखैः <ls>Ś. 4. 6</ls>; चरणारविन्दविश्लेष <ls>R. 13. 23</ls>. .²4 Absence, loss, bereavement. .²5 A chasm. .²6 (In <ab>Arith.</ab>) The converse of addition.
